title: Full satisfaction and zero cost
statement: Let a constraint satisfaction instance have a nonempty multiset of constraints in which every variable occurs, and let an assignment of labels be given. The assignment satisfies every constraint if and only if its total unsatisfied cost, counted with constraint multiplicities, is zero.
hypotheses_covered: Every declared variable occurs in some constraint scope
